slots.notes: Fullscreen looping hero background video filling the left panel (object-cover, autoplay, muted, playsInline, no overlay/tint allowed).
Brand/logo glyph in the hero lockup beside the wordmark; native is the Lucide 'Circle' icon filled white (fill-white text-white).
Two social-login provider glyphs inside the SocialButton grid; native are Lucide 'Chrome' (Google) and 'Github' icons.
Password show/hide toggle glyph absolutely positioned at the right of the password input; native is the Lucide 'Eye' icon.

mechanic: Two-column lg split with a fullscreen looping video behind a motion staggerChildren fade-and-rise hero lockup, beside a single easeOut fade-in sign-up form column.
techDelivery: single-file React + TypeScript (App.tsx + index.css) with Tailwind CSS v4 @theme tokens, motion/react animations, and lucide-react icons.
reskinNotes: Hero video URL is hardcoded as a CRITICAL exact CDN string with an explicit no-overlay constraint; all copy is hardcoded in markup; colors are Tailwind utility opacities (white/40, white/20, white/10, white/30) plus a single --color-brand-gray token rather than full semantic CSS variables, so accent2 has no native value; icons are Lucide components not swappable image assets.
